I fixed all five bugs in `src/cart.js` and wrote regression tests for each one. All 82 tests pass and lint is clean.

## The five bugs and fixes

| # | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `addItem` accepted negative prices and quantities, so a negative quantity could shrink an existing line | It now checks name, price and quantity before changing anything. Price must be a number ≥ 0. Quantity must be a whole number ≥ 1. It also refuses to merge past `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. |
| 2 | `filter(i => i.name = name)` assigned instead of comparing: it renamed every item to the removed name and kept them all. Missing items were silently ignored. | It removes only the exact match, and throws `CartItemNotFoundError` (with `.itemName`) if the item isn't in the cart. |
| 3 | The `<=` loop read past the end, so `getTotal()` threw on every cart, even an empty one | Replaced the loop with a `reduce` over the items. |
| 4 | The discount was added to the total | It's now subtracted. |
| 5 | `applyDiscount` accepted anything, including 150, -10 and `NaN` | It accepts only numbers from 0 to 100; a rejected value keeps the previous discount. |

Bad types throw `TypeError` and out-of-range values throw `RangeError`. Either way, a failed call leaves the cart unchanged.

## Verification
- **Before the fixes:** 75 of 81 tests failed against the original code, including all 13 tests named `bug N:` in `tests/cart.test.js`.
- **Each bug on its own:** in a scratch copy, I put each bug back one at a time. Every one of that bug's tests failed each time.
- **Now:** 82 of 82 tests pass with `npm test`, and `npm run lint` is clean. One lint rule (`no-return-assign`) also flags bug 2 in the original file.

## Files
- **Source:** `src/cart.js` (still `module.exports = ShoppingCart`), `src/validation.js`, `src/errors.js`, and `src/index.js` as the package entry point.
- **Tests:**
  - `tests/cart.test.js` covers everything you asked for.
  - `tests/cart.edge.test.js` covers separate carts, size limits, bad input types, unicode names and large volumes.
  - `tests/cart.integration.test.js` runs full flows through the package entry point.
- **Other:** `package.json` (tests use Node's built-in runner; ESLint is a dev dependency), `eslint.config.js`, `README.md`.

## Decisions you may want to change
- **Removing an item that isn't there throws** rather than doing nothing. It's usually a caller mistake, and a no-op would hide it.
- **Adding an existing name keeps the first price,** as the original code did. Whether a new price should replace or reject the line is your call.
- **`getItemCount()` counts distinct lines,** not the total quantity.
- **Names must match exactly:** case and whitespace count, and two Unicode spellings of "café" are two separate items.
- **Totals aren't rounded to cents.** For exact money math, pass prices as integers in cents.

## Process notes
- The work is in six commits on the `fix/shopping-cart-bugs` branch. There's no remote, so nothing was pushed.
- I didn't touch or commit your `CLAUDE.md`.
- A project hook rejected my first commit message. I switched all commits to Conventional Commit format with the `Co-Authored-By: Dex` trailer it asked for.
- The CLAUDE.md asks for a `humanizer` skill before writing prose, but it isn't installed here, so I wrote the README in plain style myself.
